summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Remove/Re-list from QRU Store feature. All acceptance criteria pass. Public book count correctly transitions 8 → 7 (remove) → 8 (relist). Frontend UI on /book-manufacturing correctly toggles between store-status-live/remove-from-store-btn and store-status-off/relist-to-store-btn. Regression: preview-inspection-panel and product-family-page still render. Public store restored to original state (8 live books).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (console error observed on multiple pages). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional cleanup: fix React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in Layout (App.js:138 area) — not blocking but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: remove-from-store uses window.confirm + window.prompt; consider replacing with shadcn Dialog for better UX and testability.
Backend correctly rejects relist for never-listed books with HTTP 400 and a clear message referencing Founder Release Review — good UX.
seed_data_creation: None. Test book 'The Understanding Tree' was removed then re-listed; store state restored to 8 live books.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Store remove/relist feature is fully verified. Public feed lives at /api/public/books. Remove endpoint: POST /api/book-mfg/books/{id}/remove-from-store (auth). Relist: POST /api/book-mfg/books/{id}/relist-to-store — returns 400 for never-listed books. Frontend testids: store-listing-row, store-status-live, store-status-off, remove-from-store-btn, relist-to-store-btn. Uses window.confirm + window.prompt so Playwright dialog handler required (accept both).

test_results_detail.backend_relist_never_listed: PASS — HTTP 400 with message referencing Founder Release Review (book id 9b9e22ed…)
test_results_detail.frontend_remove_flow: PASS (after remove: store-status-off + relist-to-store-btn shown; public count = 7)
test_results_detail.frontend_relist_flow: PASS (after relist: store-status-live + remove-from-store-btn restored; public count = 8)
